sections.text: Visually check the oil level in the circuit breaker oil tank at the advisable level between the maximum and minimum marks on the oil level gauge.

By binocular check the oil level of the bushings, the oil glass indicator must be full of
 oil.
Check the oil level in the pump tank, oil level must be between the two marks of the gauge.
Check all the oil tubes and all its connections to detect any leakage.
